About Proforto 
Proforto is the biggest name in workwear in the Benelux, and Italy is where we go next. 
We started in 2014 on a simple premise: kitting out a workforce shouldn't be a hassle. Today, tens of thousands of companies in construction, industry, healthcare, hospitality and transport buy their gear from us. Around 250,000 products from 140 brands, from work trousers and jackets to safety boots, gloves, helmets and PPE, with logos printed and embroidered in-house.
